identity.title: List of Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! volumes

source.sourceCategory: Category:Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! volumes

leadText:
This is a list of volumes of the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! created by 伊原しげかつ Shigekatsu Ihara. There are eight volumes in total, all of which have been released in English by both VIZ Media and Chuang Yi.

 

 

 
 

it:Elenco dei volumi di Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!
zh:宝可梦钻石・珍珠篇单行本列表
